record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>, when he was in the wilderness<WH04057> of Judah<WH03063>.<Fo><Fo> O God<WH0430>, thou <FI>art<Fi> my God<WH0410>; early will I seek<WH07836><WTH8762> thee: my soul<WH05315> thirsteth<WH06770><WTH8804> for thee, my flesh<WH01320> longeth<WH03642><WTH8804> for thee in a dry<WH06723> and thirsty<WH05889> land<WH0776>, where no<WH01097> water<WH04325> is; <RF>thirsty: Heb. weary<Rf> <RF>where...: without water<Rf>
To see<WH07200><WTH8800> thy power<WH05797> and thy glory<WH03519>, so <FI>as<Fi> I have seen<WH02372><WTH8804> thee in the sanctuary<WH06944>.<CM>
Because thy lovingkindness<WH02617> <FI>is<Fi> better<WH02896> than life<WH02416>, my lips<WH08193> shall praise<WH07623><WTH8762> thee.
Thus will I bless<WH01288><WTH8762> thee while I live<WH02416>: I will lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> my hands<WH03709> in thy name<WH08034>.

My soul<WH05315> shall be satisfied<WH07646><WTH8799> as <FI>with<Fi> marrow<WH02459> and fatness<WH01880>; and my mouth<WH06310> shall praise<WH01984><WTH8762> <FI>thee<Fi> with joyful<WH07445> lips<WH08193>: <RF>marrow: Heb. fatness<Rf>
When I remember<WH02142><WTH8804> thee upon my bed<WH03326>, <FI>and<Fi> meditate<WH01897><WTH8799> on thee in the <FI>night<Fi> watches<WH0821>.<CM>
Because thou hast been my help<WH05833>, therefore in the shadow<WH06738> of thy wings<WH03671> will I rejoice<WH07442><WTH8762>.
My soul<WH05315> followeth hard<WH01692><WTH8804> after<WH0310> thee: thy right hand<WH03225> upholdeth<WH08551><WTH8804> me.
But those <FI>that<Fi> seek<WH01245><WTH8762> my soul<WH05315>, to destroy<WH07722> <FI>it<Fi> , shall go<WH0935><WTH8799> into the lower parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>.

They shall fall<WH05064><WTH8686> by the sword<WH03027><WH02719>: they shall be a portion<WH04521> for foxes<WH07776>. <RF>They shall fall...: Heb. They shall make him run out like water by the hands of<Rf>

But the king<WH04428> shall rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> in God<WH0430>; every one that sweareth<WH07650><WTH8737> by him shall glory<WH01984><WTH8691>: but the mouth<WH06310> of them that speak<WH01696><WTH8802> lies<WH08267> shall be stopped<WH05534><WTH8735>.<CM>
